# R. M. Hare

*1919 – 2002 · British · [Analytic Philosophy](../movements/analytic-philosophy.md)*

Oxford moral philosopher: in *The Language of Morals* (1952), he argued that moral judgements are universalizable prescriptions, a kind of imperative, not descriptions of the world.
